image.subject: Uncle Andrew, an old man with wild grey hair and a dressing gown, turning a key in a locked study door while Digory and Polly stand behind him in a dusty Edwardian 1900 London attic

storyboard.claim: Andrew traps the children in his study.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Andrew locks the door on the two children.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues from the smugglers cave to the locked study.
storyboard.addedInformation: Andrew is the one who controls the door.

image.subject: Uncle Andrew, wild grey hair and a sharply pointed nose, standing proudly before a tall bookcase of old leather tomes in his study, one hand raised as if lecturing

storyboard.claim: Andrew is a magician driven by ego.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Andrew posing as a lecturing scholar-magician.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Andrew is now introduced after being locked in.
storyboard.addedInformation: His vanity is visible in his posture.

image.subject: Uncle Andrew in his dressing gown peering into a gilt mirror in a candlelit study, admiring himself while a yellow ring sits untouched on a table nearby

storyboard.claim: Andrew wants wisdom but will not take risks.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Andrew admires himself but keeps away from the ring.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows Andrew's ego with his refusal to risk anything.
storyboard.addedInformation: The ring stays on the table, showing he avoids danger.

image.subject: A red wooden tray in a dusty attic study holding a glowing yellow ring beside a small empty wire cage, the guinea pig gone

storyboard.claim: Andrew has already sent a guinea pig away with a yellow ring.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The guinea pig has vanished; a yellow ring glows on the tray beside its empty cage.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from Andrew's ego to his experiment.
storyboard.addedInformation: The guinea pig is the first test subject, already gone.

storyboard.claim: Andrew's complaint is that the guinea pig cannot take notes.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Andrew's complaint follows the experiment.
storyboard.addedInformation: It shows he cares about results, not the animal.

image.subject: A busy Edwardian London street in 1900 with horse cabs, gaslamps and people in heavy coats under a grey sky

storyboard.claim: London at the height of the empire, 1900.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A horse-cab street in 1900 London.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from Andrew to the wider time and place.
storyboard.addedInformation: The era is shown through the street.

image.subject: Well-dressed Edwardian gentlemen and ladies seated around a candlelit seance table in a dim London drawing room, hands joined

storyboard.claim: Upper-class London was obsessed with the occult.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A candlelit seance in a London drawing room.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the London setting that produced Andrew.
storyboard.addedInformation: The occult interest belongs to the upper classes.

image.subject: An ornate ancient carved box with foreign symbols sitting on a polished Victorian study desk beside a pile of brass instruments

storyboard.claim: Ancient mysticism was treated as a resource to extract.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An ancient carved box treated as a collectors object.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the attitude behind Andrew's study.
storyboard.addedInformation: The box is the source of Andrew's power.

image.subject: An elderly relative's pale hand pushing a heavy carved wooden box across a bedside table in an Edwardian bedroom

storyboard.claim: Andrew inherited the box from a dying relative.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An elderly hand passing a carved box across a bedside table.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains where Andrew got the box.
storyboard.addedInformation: The box passed down through a family death.

storyboard.claim: Andrew brute forced the box as a trust fund academic.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text list only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes how Andrew used the box.
storyboard.addedInformation: Three traits of Andrew.

storyboard.claim: Andrew says his is a high and lonely destiny.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Andrew's own words after the method.
storyboard.addedInformation: The quote is his self-image.

image.subject: Uncle Andrew standing before a shelf of leather-bound books in his study, chin lifted, as if he is above the common rules

storyboard.claim: Andrew argues that men of hidden wisdom are above common rules.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Andrew stands above ordinary life among his books.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues Andrew's self-image.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows his belief in his own superiority.

storyboard.claim: Should we see Andrew as a mastermind?
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The commentary challenges the earlier view.
storyboard.addedInformation: Asks the viewer to reassess Andrew.

image.subject: Uncle Andrew cowering behind a high-backed chair in his dressing gown, eyes wide, while a glowing yellow ring sits on a tray across the room

storyboard.claim: Andrew is a pathetic coward terrified of his own toys.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Andrew hides behind a chair from the ring.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the mastermind question.
storyboard.addedInformation: His fear is shown physically.

image.subject: A leather-bound philosophy book open on a study desk, beside a yellow ring and a half-empty glass of wine

storyboard.claim: Andrew dresses his cowardice in grand philosophical language.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An open philosophy book on a desk with the ring.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the grandiose talk of the coward.
storyboard.addedInformation: The book gives him the language.

image.subject: Uncle Andrew's trembling hands gripping the edge of a study table, his knuckles pale, his pointed nose raised toward a humming ring

storyboard.claim: Andrew is shaking with terror of the unknown.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Trembling hands gripping a table.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the coward view.
storyboard.addedInformation: Fear is shown in his hands.

image.subject: Uncle Andrew peering at a humming ring from across a dusty attic, keeping a safe distance behind a wooden chair

storyboard.claim: His cowardice is undeniable, rooted in fear of the unknown.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Andrew keeps his distance from the ring.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the cause of his cowardice.
storyboard.addedInformation: Distance shows the fear.

storyboard.claim: Cowardice does not cancel his arrogance; it amplifies his cruelty.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns the coward view into a danger.
storyboard.addedInformation: Cowardice makes him more cruel.

image.subject: Uncle Andrew at his study table holding out a glowing yellow ring to Polly, a girl of about eleven with dark plaited hair and a pinafore dress, while Digory watches

storyboard.claim: Andrew uses a child to test the ring.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Andrew offers the ring to Polly.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from Andrew's fear to his cruelty.
storyboard.addedInformation: Polly is the test subject.

image.subject: An empty study chair beside a red wooden tray where a humming yellow ring still glows, and a single dark plait ribbon lies on the rug

storyboard.claim: Polly disappears after touching the ring.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Empty chair and glowing ring, no person.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the manipulation with the result.
storyboard.addedInformation: Polly is gone; the ring remains.

image.subject: Digory Kirke, a slim English boy of about eleven with short untidy brown hair, pocketing two green rings while Uncle Andrew watches from the doorway

storyboard.claim: Andrew forces Digory to take green rings to go after Polly.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Digory pockets the green rings under Andrew's eye.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Digory is now the one who must act.
storyboard.addedInformation: Digory is forced to follow.

image.subject: Digory Kirke standing alone in the attic, two green rings in his palm and a yellow ring on a tray in front of him, his face grave

storyboard.claim: A grieving child is handed power he cannot undo.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Digory alone holding the rings.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the burden on Digory.
storyboard.addedInformation: The weight falls on the child.

image.subject: Digory Kirke mid-leap in a swirling dark void, a yellow ring glowing on his finger, his grey jacket flung out

storyboard.claim: Digory plunges into the void to fix Andrew's mistake.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Digory falling into a swirling void.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Digory is sent after Polly.
storyboard.addedInformation: The void is the passage between worlds.

storyboard.claim: Digory is pulled out of the study into the wood between the worlds.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The void drops him in a new place.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the setting.

storyboard.claim: The move from the study to the wood is a sensory shock.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the place card.
storyboard.addedInformation: Lewis makes the change feel abrupt.

image.subject: Digory and Polly standing in a warm green wood with dense leaves, the stuffy attic gone behind them

storyboard.claim: The children go from the stuffy room to a lush wood.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two children in green light, no attic.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the shock with the arrival.
storyboard.addedInformation: Contrast between the two places.

image.subject: A warm lush green wood with dense leaves and sunlight filtering down, the richest greenest woods imaginable

storyboard.claim: The wood is the richest, warmest woods.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A lush green wood.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes the wood Digory has entered.
storyboard.addedInformation: Warmth and richness.

image.subject: A forest floor bathed entirely in green light under dense leaves, perfectly still and silent

storyboard.claim: The light is green and the quiet is dead and still.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Still green forest floor.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the wood description.
storyboard.addedInformation: The quiet is calm, not tense.

image.subject: A mossy forest floor dotted with dozens of perfectly circular still pools of water, one pool reflecting green leaves

storyboard.claim: The ground is dotted with circular pools of water.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Round still pools on the mossy floor.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes the ground of the wood.
storyboard.addedInformation: The pools are the doorways.

image.subject: Digory Kirke leaning against a tree trunk in green light, eyes half-closed, looking heavy and warm with apathy

storyboard.claim: Digory feels a heavy warm apathy in the wood.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Digory leaning against a tree.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Digory reacts to the wood.
storyboard.addedInformation: His mood is shown.

left.label: LONDON
left.subject: a dark crawlspace tunnel under rooftop slates in a Victorian London house

right.label: THE WOOD
right.subject: a still circular pool of water in a green forest

storyboard.claim: The wood is like the dark tunnel under London roofs.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A London roof-slate crawlspace on one side, a still pool in the green wood on the other.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Digory compares the wood to London.
storyboard.addedInformation: The wood connects the houses.

image.subject: A branching network of still pools reflecting green light across a forest floor, each pool linking to another

storyboard.claim: The wood is cosmic plumbing between the universes.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Linked pools like connecting pipes.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains what the wood is.
storyboard.addedInformation: The wood is not a universe itself.

image.subject: A dim Victorian London Underground tunnel junction in 1900, rails crossing under gaslight, no train in sight

storyboard.claim: The wood is like a subway junction where lines cross.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A dim tunnel junction with crossing rails.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the plumbing analogy.
storyboard.addedInformation: Era-correct underground.

storyboard.claim: Nothing happens in the wood; it only connects.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the junction analogy.
storyboard.addedInformation: The wood is purely a link.

image.subject: Uncle Andrew in his study holding a yellow ring up triumphantly, confident that the magic is simple

storyboard.claim: Andrew thought the magic was simple.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Andrew confidently holding a ring.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains Andrew's misunderstanding.
storyboard.addedInformation: His overconfidence is the flaw.

storyboard.claim: Yellow means outward, green means homeward.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text list only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Andrew's binary understanding.
storyboard.addedInformation: The rule Andrew believed.

image.subject: Close view of glittering dust grains caught in a sunbeam above a red wooden tray with yellow and green rings

storyboard.claim: The physics of the rings is more than Andrew knows.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Dust in a sunbeam above the rings.
storyboard.onScreenText: WHAT THE RINGS ARE MADE OF
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the binary rule to what the rings are made of.
storyboard.addedInformation: The dust is the key.

image.subject: A pinch of glittering dust on a red wooden tray beside yellow and green rings, the dust carried to London from a green wood long ago

storyboard.claim: The rings are made of dust from the wood.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Dust on a tray beside the rings.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the physics.
storyboard.addedInformation: Origin of the rings.

image.subject: A yellow ring glowing and being drawn toward a green pool in the wood, the light stretching toward the water

storyboard.claim: Yellow rings are drawn back to their origin.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Yellow ring pulled toward a pool.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the yellow ring's pull.
storyboard.addedInformation: Yellow pulls you into the wood.

left.label: YELLOW
left.subject: a yellow ring pulled inward toward a green pool

right.label: GREEN
right.subject: a green ring pushed outward away from a green pool

storyboard.claim: Green rings push out, yellow rings pull in, like magnetic poles.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Yellow pulled in, green pushed out.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the yellow pull with the green push.
storyboard.addedInformation: Magnetic polarity.

image.subject: Uncle Andrew kneeling on the attic floor and scattering rings across a tray, like a careless child playing with magnets

storyboard.claim: Andrew is like a toddler with powerful magnets.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Andrew careless with the rings.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Puts Andrew in the magnet analogy.
storyboard.addedInformation: He is careless with power.

image.subject: A green ring glowing above a cold wet London street with gaslamps, the ring pointing away from home

storyboard.claim: A green ring does not take you home to London.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Green ring over a London street, not leading there.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The green ring's false promise.
storyboard.addedInformation: Green does not return to London.

image.subject: A green ring glowing above a still circular pool, ripples spreading, the ring shoving the wearer toward the water

storyboard.claim: The green ring repels you into any pool.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Ripples from a pool beneath a green ring.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the green ring not going home.
storyboard.addedInformation: Random destination.

storyboard.claim: The realisation is terrifying: power without understanding.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Summarises the ring physics.
storyboard.addedInformation: Power without understanding.

storyboard.claim: Wielding forces you do not understand leaves you at their mercy.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the lesson.
storyboard.addedInformation: General warning.

image.subject: The reflection of a green ring in dark still water, the surface barely moving under green light

storyboard.claim: You are at the mercy of the forces' actual nature.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Green ring reflected in still water.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the warning.
storyboard.addedInformation: The water shows the real nature.

image.subject: A dense green wood with still pools in soft light, quiet and inviting, nothing visibly threatening

storyboard.claim: The actual nature of the wood is insidious.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Calm dense wood with pools.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Ends the passage on the wood.
storyboard.addedInformation: The threat is quiet, not shown.
